Manage work allocation among the team and ensure back up plans are in place.

• Review general ledger exceptions. Identify cause and make necessary adjustment.     
     
    
    
Accenture Services    
     
Associate, Trade Settlement –Mutual/Hybrid Funds | Nov2023 – Dec 2024

standard tools for efficient trade matching, confirmation, and settlement in the FX market. These platforms 
streamline communication and trade processing among diverse counterparties. Coordinated client meeting, 
trained teams, and maintained process documentation (MoMs, updates).
